failure_modes.detail: The tool works on TEXT only — it cannot evaluate visual impact, actor performance quality, or cinematographic appeal that a human editor sees.
Keyword-based scoring may miss subtle drama (quiet menace, loaded silences, implied threats) that doesn't use explicitly dramatic vocabulary.
The tool cannot judge audio — music swells, sound effects, and voice tone are major factors in promo effectiveness that text analysis misses.
